posts.name: Shriniketh K
posts.cooked: I did not do week 7 graded assginment which means i cant write oppe 2. Will this mean i have to repeat the cource(only oppe) now because of this?

posts.name: Adul P R
posts.cooked:
If you scored at least 40% in OPPE 1, then it’s not mandatory to repeat it.
However, if you didn’t pass OPPE 1 and also missed your GRPA ( not GA) submissions of week 7, then you’ll have to repeat the OPPE.

if you’ve managed to submit at least 7 out of the 16 GRPAs of week 7, you’re still on track.

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
NotKnox:

t states "Minimum score to be obtained in one of the programming exams (OPPE1, OPPE2) should be >= 40/100 " this is extreemly confusing so please explain this to me.

It means you have to score at least 40marks in any one oppe. Either you score >=40 in OPPE1 or >=40 in OPPE2 or in both.
To pass oppe your score should be >=40 in at least one of the oppe.
